Tiranga Handloom is a fabric manufacturing company focused on developing business relationships and expanding its customer base across the textile and apparel industry. We are looking for a highly motivated, result-oriented Business Development Executive who can generate qualified leads, connect with potential buyers, and convert business opportunities into confirmed orders.

Confirmed orders and revenue generated. This is a target-driven role. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of business development, follows up persistently, and focuses on converting opportunities into actual sales rather than simply making calls.

You recruit them as introducers (they earn on every deal they bring), keep them warm, and own this channel. Referral chains — every conversation, even the rejections, ends with “Which owner-friend of yours has this same problem?” You'll sell shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders : you get us into the room and own the relationship; founders run the demo and the close — for now. Master the product, and the close becomes yours. That path is real, and it's written down. In the interview, we'll ask you to open your phone and show us. We mean it. Street smart over MBA smart — you know who the real decision-maker is, who influences them, and how to move both Trusted first, then bought from — because you're genuinely curious, not because you read a sales book Fluent Hindi, own vehicle, already living in your city's industrial world Hungry: you've hit the ceiling where you are, and you want a job where the ceiling is yours to set You don't need polished English, a SaaS background, ji or an MBA. We'll teach you the product. We can't teach hunger, trust, or years of relationships.
